sourceInventory.catalog: language-data calls jinja() and liquid() with no arguments
sourceInventory.defaults: Both modules allocate one html() base per module; Text/RawText overlay; HTML receives default dialect/routes, stock schema, tag handler, non-JSX javascript().support, and css().support

sourceInventory.input: Actual input handlers and defaults; private view helpers exposed in memory; DOM diff detection and IME events not simulated.
